user.title: Add a Sky Q box
user.description: These Sky Q boxes were found on your network. Add the gateway (main box) first so Minis are linked to it.

manual.title: Add a Sky Q box
manual.description: Enter the IP address of a Sky Q gateway or Mini. Give the box a fixed address in your router so it keeps working.

confirm.title: Add {name}?
confirm.description: Found a Sky Q box ({model}) at {host}.

reconfigure.title: Change the box's address
reconfigure.description: Enter the new IP address of this Sky Q box.

error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach a Sky Q box at that address. Check the box is on (not unplugged) and on the same network.

abort.already_configured: This box is already set up.
abort.already_in_progress: This box is already being set up.
abort.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach the Sky Q box.
abort.unsupported_device: This device isn't a Sky Q set-top box. Sky Glass and Sky Stream aren't supported.
abort.no_unique_id: The box didn't report a serial number or MAC address, so it can't be added.
abort.wrong_device: That address belongs to a different Sky Q box. Add it separately instead.

data_description.key_gap: Sky Q ignores key presses that arrive too quickly. Increase this if channel changes miss digits.
data_description.scan_interval: Channel changes aren't pushed by the box, so it is polled at this interval while it's on (every 30 s in standby).

unreachable.message: The Sky Q box at {host} isn't responding.

wrong_device.message: The box at {host} is a different Sky Q box than this entry was set up for. Reconfigure the entry with the right address.

command_failed.message: The Sky Q box didn't accept the command: {error}

unknown_source.message: {source} isn't one of this box's channels.

invalid_channel.message: {channel} isn't a channel number. Use digits such as 101, or sid:3008.

unsupported_media_type.message: Can't play media of type {media_type}. Use channel, app or keys.

no_channel.message: This box isn't showing a TV channel. Name the channels to look up.

unknown_channel.message: {channel} isn't one of this box's channels.

guide_unavailable.message: Sky's TV guide couldn't be reached: {error}

unknown_media.message: {media_id} isn't something this box can browse.

unknown_recording.message: There's no recording with ID {recording_id}. Get IDs from Get recordings.

nothing_to_update.message: Choose at least one thing to change: keep, locked, series link or resume position.

resume_backwards.message: Sky Q can only move the resume position forward ({position} s is before the current {current} s).

no_programme.message: This box isn't showing a programme from the TV guide, so there's nothing to record.

no_recordings.message: The recordings list hasn't been fetched yet. Try again in a moment.

send_keys.name: Send keys
send_keys.description: Presses a sequence of remote keys on a Sky Q box.

keys.name: Keys
keys.description: Key names in order, for example backup, 1, 0, 1 or tv_guide.

delay.name: Delay
delay.description: Seconds between keys. Leave empty to use the integration's key delay.

change_channel.name: Change channel
change_channel.description: Tunes a Sky Q box to a channel by typing its number.

channel.name: Channel
channel.description: Channel number such as 101, or sid:3008 for a service ID.

launch_app.name: Open app
launch_app.description: Opens an installed app on a Sky Q box.

app.name: App
app.description: App name or ID, for example YouTube or Netflix.

get_guide.name: Get TV guide
get_guide.description: Returns programmes from Sky's TV guide, with event IDs you can pass to Record.

channels.name: Channels
channels.description: Channel numbers, names or sid:service IDs. Leave empty for the channel the box is showing, or for every channel when searching.

start.name: Start
start.description: Start of the time window. Leave empty for now. The guide covers about 8 days ahead.

search.name: Search
search.description: Only return programmes whose title contains this text.

record.name: Record
record.description: Books a recording of a programme from the TV guide. Recordings are stored on the gateway; booking from a Mini works too.

event_id.name: Event ID
event_id.description: The programme's event ID, from Get TV guide or the media player's event_id attribute.

series.name: Series link
series.description: Record every episode of the series.

record_now.name: Record what's on
record_now.description: Records the programme on now on this box's channel.

series.name: Series link
series.description: Record every episode of the series.

delete_recording.name: Delete recording
delete_recording.description: Deletes a recording, or cancels a scheduled one. Deleted recordings go to the box's trash and can be restored, unless deleted permanently.

recording_id.name: Recording ID
recording_id.description: The recording's ID (starts with P), from Get recordings or a recordings calendar event.

permanent.name: Permanently
permanent.description: Erase it for good instead of moving it to the trash. This can't be undone.

restore_recording.name: Restore recording
restore_recording.description: Brings a deleted recording back from the trash.

recording_id.name: Recording ID
recording_id.description: The recording's ID (starts with P), from Get recordings or a recordings calendar event.

stop_recording.name: Stop recording
stop_recording.description: Stops a recording in progress and keeps what's been recorded so far.

recording_id.name: Recording ID
recording_id.description: The recording's ID (starts with P), from Get recordings or a recordings calendar event.

update_recording.name: Update recording
update_recording.description: Changes a recording's settings. Only the fields you set are changed.

recording_id.name: Recording ID
recording_id.description: The recording's ID (starts with P), from Get recordings or a recordings calendar event.

keep.name: Keep
keep.description: Protect it from automatic deletion when the disk is full.

locked.name: Locked
locked.description: Require the PIN to play it.

series_link.name: Series link
series_link.description: Record future episodes of the series.

resume_position.name: Resume position
resume_position.description: Where playback resumes, in seconds from the start. Sky Q can only move it forward.

get_recordings.name: Get recordings
get_recordings.description: Returns the household's recordings: scheduled ones soonest first, then the rest newest first.

status.name: Status
status.description: Only these kinds. Leave empty for everything except deleted recordings.

search.name: Search
search.description: Only recordings whose title contains this text.

get_channels.name: Get channels
get_channels.description: Returns every channel on the box, with numbers, service IDs, genres and favourite positions.

get_apps.name: Get apps
get_apps.description: Returns the apps installed on the box, with the IDs Open app accepts.
